fin_bridge_observations.sequence: Lower tines print, then a line perpendicular to the bridge raster above the tines. Bridge strands fall away and the roof collapses.
fin_bridge_observations.user_interpretation: The horizontal bridge lines do not overlap the vertical line or supported material.

solid_anchor_bridge_observations.retained_underside: Strictly worse than a supported underside; supported undersides are already unsatisfactory.
solid_anchor_bridge_observations.scope: Formation demonstrated at 2, 4, 6 and 8 mm, plus 4 mm rotated; no clean underside or universal span limit.

slope_observations.id_assignment_basis: Inference from the reported four of six, earlier angle-specific inspection, and photos; the latest report does not explicitly name each ID.
slope_observations.scope: Full-height run completed. Edge quality only; no sliding, bonding or strength acceptance.

interpretation: F roofs print inner and outer perimeters before the axial bridge raster. Most far-end raster centers are between the preceding teeth.
F2 has 6 of 28 far-end centers on prior beads; 14 of 28 nominal endpoint bead envelopes touch prior beads. The others rely on the new perimeter.
The middle raster has about 0.11 mm nominal overlap with the inner roof wall. Literal non-overlap everywhere is not established by G-code.
C stability with failed F formation supports a fin-landing/perimeter mechanism rather than a 2 mm free-span limit.
C underside quality does not meet the stated surface objective. Repairing F formation alone would not establish useful fin-supported finish.
